name: Yanase Mashiho
source: A girl who talks and laughs a lot, has a light movement, and is fashionable, Mashiho is popular in class. However when she's left alone with Masaru, she becomes an abusing queen and acts big. No one knows her true face.
translation: A girl who talks and laughs a lot, has a light movement, and is fashionable, Mashiho is popular in class. However when she's left alone with Masaru, she becomes an abusing queen and acts big. No one knows her true face.
